title: Combinatorial manifolds and Kleene's theorem, homotopically
summary: We give a general method to build categories of combinatorial manifolds, i.e. categories of combinatorial objects satisfying some local property at every "point", as coreflective subcategories of categories of relational presheaves. To do this, we crucially rely on unique factorization systems, and we can interpet our technique as a way of building a model category whose cofibrant objects are exactly the combinatorial manifolds.
